open: In the name of Allah. Assalamu alaikum, my dears. Come closer, tonight’s story is very beautiful.
s1a: Noah… Ilyas… Do you remember Yusuf’s dream? Eleven stars, the sun and the moon… and they all bowed down to him. Today you will finally find out what this dream means!
s1c: Exactly that. Get warm and cosy… Today I’ll tell you about the Prophet Yusuf, peace be upon him. His story has a whole surah in the Qur’an named after him: Surah Yusuf.
s2a: Yusuf’s brothers were jealous of him. They said: “Yusuf and his brother are more beloved to our father than we”! And they wanted to get rid of Yusuf. One of them said: Throw him into a deep well; perhaps some travellers will take him.
s2b: And so it happened. But in the dark well, Yusuf was not alone. Allah inspired to him: “You will surely inform them about this affair of theirs.” That means: one day you will tell them what they did. Soon a caravan came. One of them let his bucket down into the well and called out: “Good news! Here is a boy!”
s2c: Alhamdulillah! Did they take him back home?
s2d: No, my dear. They sold him for a few coins. A man from Egypt bought him and said to his wife: “Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son.” And when Yusuf grew up, Allah said: “We gave him judgment and knowledge.”
s3a: Yusuf became a handsome, good young man. One day, the wife of the master of the house wanted him to do something that Allah has forbidden. But Yusuf said: “I seek the refuge of Allah!” And he hurried to the door. She pulled his shirt from behind, and it tore.
s3b: From behind? And why is that important?
s3c: Good question! A man from her family said: If his shirt is torn from behind, then Yusuf is the one telling the truth, because he was running away. And that is exactly how it was! Still, Yusuf went to prison. But he had prayed to Allah: “My Lord, prison is more to my liking than that to which they invite me.”
s4a: In the prison there were two young men. Each of them had a dream, and they asked Yusuf what it meant. Yusuf first said: I worship Allah alone, “and I have followed the religion of my fathers, Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaqub.” And after that he explained their dreams.
s4b: To the first he said: You will go out and serve your master drink again. As for the other, his dream had a sad meaning. And Yusuf said to the first: “Mention me before your master.” But Satan made him forget. And Yusuf remained in prison several years.
s4c: Several years? That’s a long time!
s5a: Then the king of Egypt had a strange dream: seven fat cows were eaten by seven thin cows. And he saw seven green ears of grain, and others that were dry. No one could explain the dream. Then the man who had been in prison finally remembered Yusuf!
s5b: Yusuf explained the dream and said: For seven years there will be plenty of wheat. Store it well! Then seven hard years will come, in which you will eat from what you stored. And after that a good year will come again.
s5c: The king said: Bring Yusuf to me! But Yusuf said: First it must be made clear that I am innocent. And indeed, the wife of the master of the house admitted that Yusuf had told the truth. Yusuf said: “Appoint me over the storehouses of the land. Indeed, I will be a knowing guardian.” And so Yusuf became responsible for all the food stores in Egypt.
s6a: Then the hard years came, even in Yaqub’s land. Yusuf’s brothers travelled to Egypt to get wheat. “And he recognized them, but he was to them unknown.”
s6b: They had no idea it was Yusuf!
s6c: With a plan that Allah inspired in him, Yusuf kept his brother with him. And when the others came back, he said to them: “I am Yusuf, and this is my brother. Allah has certainly favored us.”
s6d: The brothers said: “By Allah, certainly has Allah preferred you over us, and indeed, we have been sinners.” And what did Yusuf say? He said: “No blame will there be upon you today. Allah will forgive you; and He is the most merciful of the merciful.”
s6e: He just forgave them? After everything they did?
s6f: Yes, my dear. Forgiving is sometimes harder than anything else. And that is exactly what Yusuf did.
s7a: Yusuf gave them his shirt and said: “Take this, my shirt, and cast it over the face of my father; he will become seeing.” And when the caravan departed from Egypt, Yaqub said, far away: “Indeed, I find the smell of Yusuf”! They put the shirt on his face, and Yaqub could see again!
s7b: The whole family came to Egypt. Yusuf raised his parents upon the throne, “and they bowed to him in prostration” as a greeting. At that time it was allowed, but today we prostrate only to Allah. And Yusuf said: “O my father, this is the explanation of my vision of before. My Lord has made it reality.”
s7c: The eleven stars were the brothers! And the sun and the moon were the parents!
s7d: Exactly, my clever dear. And Yusuf prayed to his Lord: “Cause me to die a Muslim and join me with the righteous.”
s8a: Oh… they’ve fallen asleep. My dears… be honest like Yusuf, even when it is hard. Trust Allah, even when it is as dark as in a well. And forgive others, just as Yusuf forgave his brothers.
s8b: And next time, I’ll tell you about Ayyub… a prophet who became very sick and stayed patient. And you, watching us right now: if you liked the story, ask your parents to subscribe to our channel, so you don’t miss the next story.
close: And you, dear fathers and mothers: subscribe to our channel, and share these stories with the people you love, so that together we pass on the beautiful message of Islam to our children.
final: Good night, my dears. I entrust you to Allah, with whom nothing entrusted is ever lost.
